name: v1.0.1
body:
First production release of the automated release pipeline.

> **Note:** v0.2.0 and v1.0.0 are skipped — both names became permanently locked by a configuration interaction between `@semantic-release/github` and repository release-immutability that has since been fixed (see [#8](https://github.com/robinbowes/go-udap/pull/8)). v1.0.1 is the first usable release after v0.1.0.

## Highlights since v0.1.0

- **Automated release pipeline.** semantic-release computes versions from conventional-commit history; GoReleaser cross-compiles and uploads release artifacts on tag push; binaries' `--version` output is stamped from the release tag at link time.
- **Three workflows.** `ci.yaml` runs the test matrix on PRs and main pushes (linux/macos/windows). `release.yaml` runs semantic-release on main pushes. `goreleaser.yaml` runs on SemVer tag pushes — creates a draft release, attaches assets, and publishes the draft as the final step (so repository immutability locks the release with assets in place).
- **Cross-platform binaries.** linux + macOS in amd64 and arm64; windows in amd64. Five platform archives plus `SHA256SUMS`.
- **mocksbr test harness.** New `cmd/mocksbr` and `mocksbr/` package — virtual Squeezebox Receivers running on a UDP socket so tests and developers can drive `go-udap` without real hardware.
- **CLI redesign.** New dispatcher, global flags, exit codes, layered `set` sources (config file / piped stdin / per-param flags), progress bar on every device-targeted command, `read --all` to include factory defaults.
- **udap package improvements.** New `Transport` interface and `UDPTransport`. NVRAM `squeezecenter_name` parameter (offset 83) added. `RWMutex`-protected device map. Loopback packets correctly filtered. Discovery TLV types corrected — `info` now shows product name and state.

## Breaking changes

Release artifact filenames changed. Previously each GitHub release attached raw binaries named `go-udap-linux-amd64`, `go-udap.exe`, etc. Releases now attach versioned `tar.gz`/`zip` archives containing the binary plus `LICENSE` and `README.md`. Anyone with a download script that hardcodes the old filenames will need to update. Inside each archive the binary is named `go-udap` (or `go-udap.exe` on Windows).

## Verification

`SHA256SUMS` (also attached to this release) lists the SHA-256 checksum of every archive.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/robinbowes/go-udap/compare/v0.1.0...v1.0.1
